items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: I used to play with Wooden Joe's band in there... I was in the Wooden Joe's band.

ctx.x: Danny Barker. He was good. It says Danny Barker saw him when he came for a visit. Oh yeah.

I played a job with him once. But I used to play with Wooden Joe's band in there. They called him Wooden Joe because they get brusher, lyrer, and so long. Ask him who was in Wooden Joe's band. Who all was in Wooden Joe's band? Well me, John Tassel, and that was John Tassel. I was in the Wooden Joe's band.
Who was in Wooden Joe's band?

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Then I was with, uh, called it the John Casman band at that time. And we had Wooden Joe.

ctx.x: Why not? Ask me if you knew shots.

Did you know shots? Shots, huh, Ruby? I was playing with him. Shots played with us in the full place. I was playing with him. Shots was another liquor-head, too. He was a good corner player, but he was a liquor-head. Shots drank so much whiskey to the kids. He played with us until he got kind of sick. And he wasn't sick so long before he died. He was a good corner player, Shots. Which band was that? Whose band? Well, we was a make-up band, I thought. We didn't have no special name. Then I was with, uh, called it…

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: Wooden Joe. You got any name Wooden Joe?

ctx.x: I was with, let me see. I was with my wife's curtain. When it's poor, you got in there. I was with him. Then there, that. He lost that job. He wasn't paying but a dime a quarter of a night. He lost that. Then I went back with John Cavan. He stayed with John Cavan for about three years. And John, when the stick came up a little bit, John wouldn't ask the boys for a raise. That's Bill Key's bad enough, you see. Then I went from different fellas, you know. They hired me, you know. Wooden Joe. You got any name Wooden…
Ask him who was in Octaves' band.
